🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-on momentum held into the weekend as a Treasury buyback tweak, record ETF inflows and a violent short squeeze kept bitcoin near $80,000. Privacy coins and XRP led, while fresh exploits tempered the euphoria. 🏦 Treasury Buyback Tweak Powers Bitcoin's 25% Surge Toward $80,000 A change to the US Treasury's long-bond buyback program pulled long-term yields off 19-year highs and detonated a record short squeeze in a market that had leaned far too bearish, lifting bitcoin roughly 25% in a matter of days. Analysts were quick to caution that buybacks are a liquidity mechanic, not quantitative easing. Read full story 📈 Bitcoin and Ether ETFs Draw $2.6 Billion in Strongest Inflow Week Since October US spot bitcoin and ether ETFs pulled in a combined $2.6 billion over the week, their heaviest haul since October, while trading volume across the products roughly tripled. The flows mark the clearest sign yet that institutional allocators are re-engaging after a brutal summer drawdown. More details 🚀 XRP on Track for Biggest Weekly Gain in 21 Months XRP climbed roughly 50% on the week, its strongest showing since November 2024, as traders priced the Treasury's intervention as a step toward de facto yield curve control. The token led a broad altcoin bid that still has not been enough to flip bitcoin dominance. Read more 🛡️ Zcash Hits Eight-Year High Near $850 as Grayscale Pushes Spot ETF ZEC punched through levels last seen in 2018 after Grayscale filed a fresh amended registration to convert its Zcash Trust into a spot ETF listed on NYSE Arca. Futures volume approached $10 billion against a far thinner spot market — the rally is trading ahead of a decision that regulators have not yet made. See details ⚠️ The Sandbox Halts Base and BNB Chain Bridging After Exploit The Web3 gaming network disabled bridging on the affected networks to quarantine tokens after an exploit, warning users not to trade SAND on Base or BNB Chain. The team put the impact at under 0.01% of total supply, though reports on the scale of the unbacked mint conflicted. Read full story 🔄 BitMart Weighs Partial Restart and Creditor Payouts After Shutdown Notice Weeks after announcing a wind-down, the exchange is now exploring a restructuring that would restart part of its business and repay creditors.
